name: api-governance
description: Stops an agent's breaking edit to an OpenAPI, GraphQL, protobuf, AsyncAPI or MCP contract until a signed grant exists. The required check on the pull request stays the merge gate.

api_key.title: CodeRifts API key
api_key.description: Lets the mod ask CodeRifts to authorize a contract change (preflight_mode=authorize) instead of only analyzing it, and authenticates the coderifts MCP server. Sent only to https://app.coderifts.com, in the Authorization header. Leave empty to analyze without a key. Create one at https://coderifts.com/get-started/.
